versos.hebraico: וַיְבִיאֵ֖נִי אֶל־הַהֵיכָ֑ל וַיָּ֣מָד אֶת־הָאֵילִ֗ים שֵׁשׁ־אַמּ֨וֹת רֹ֧חַב־מִפּ֛וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־אַמּֽוֹת־רֹ֥חַב מִפּ֖וֹ רֹ֥חַב הָאֹֽהֶל׃

controles.web: He brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tent.
controles.kjv: Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tabernacle.
controles.livre: Então ele me levou ao templo e mediu os pilares, seis côvados a largura de um lado, e seis côvados do outro, que era a largura da tenda.

versos.hebraico: וְרֹ֣חַב הַפֶּתַח֮ עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּוֹת֒ וְכִתְפ֣וֹת הַפֶּ֔תַח חָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וְחָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפּ֑וֹ וַיָּ֤מָד אָרְכּוֹ֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֖חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃

controles.web: The breadth of the entrance was ten cubits; and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured its length, forty cubits, and the breadth, twenty cubits.
controles.kjv: And the breadth of the door was ten cubits; and the sides of the door were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.
controles.livre: E a largura da entrada era de dez côvados; e os lados da entrada, de cinco côvados de um lado, e cinco do outro. Também mediu seu comprimento de quarenta côvados, e a largura de vinte côvados.

versos.hebraico: וּבָ֣א לִפְנִ֔ימָה וַיָּ֥מָד אֵֽיל־הַפֶּ֖תַח שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֑וֹת וְהַפֶּ֨תַח֙ שֵׁ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת וְרֹ֥חַב הַפֶּ֖תַח שֶׁ֥בַע אַמּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Then went he inward, and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the breadth of the entrance, seven cubits.
controles.kjv: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.
controles.livre: Então entrou, e mediu o pilar da entrada de dois côvados, e a entrada de seis côvados; e a largura da entrada de sete côvados.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֨מָד אֶת־אָרְכּ֜וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה וְרֹ֛חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י הַֽהֵיכָ֑ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י זֶ֖ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said to me, This is the most holy place.
controles.kjv: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place.
controles.livre: Também mediu seu comprimento, de vinte côvados, e a largura de vinte côvados, diante do templo; e me disse: Este é o Santo dos Santos.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֥מָד קִֽיר־הַבַּ֖יִת שֵׁ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וְרֹ֣חַב הַצֵּלָע֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע אַמּ֜וֹת סָבִ֧יב׀ סָבִ֛יב לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.
controles.kjv: After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.
controles.livre: Depois mediu a parede do templo, de seis côvados; e quatro côvados era a largura das câmaras que ficavam de lado ao redor do templo.

versos.hebraico: וְהַצְּלָעוֹת֩ צֵלָ֨ע אֶל־צֵלָ֜ע שָׁל֧וֹשׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים פְּעָמִ֗ים וּ֠בָאוֹת בַּקִּ֨יר אֲשֶׁר־לַבַּ֧יִת לַצְּלָע֛וֹת סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִ֖יב לִהְי֣וֹת אֲחוּזִ֑ים וְלֹֽא־יִהְי֥וּ אֲחוּזִ֖ים בְּקִ֥יר הַבָּֽיִת׃

controles.web: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported, and not penetrate the wall of the house.
controles.kjv: And the side chambers were three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which was of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.
controles.livre: E as câmaras laterais eram em três andares câmara sobre câmara, e havia trinta para cada andar; e havia apoios na parede ao redor do templo, sobre os quais as câmaras se apoiavam, pois não se apoiavam na parede do templo.

versos.hebraico: וְֽרָחֲבָ֡ה וְֽנָסְבָה֩ לְמַ֨עְלָה לְמַ֜עְלָה לַצְּלָע֗וֹת כִּ֣י מֽוּסַב־הַ֠בַּיִת לְמַ֨עְלָה לְמַ֜עְלָה סָבִ֤יב׀ סָבִיב֙ לַבַּ֔יִת עַל־כֵּ֥ן רֹֽחַב־לַבַּ֖יִת לְמָ֑עְלָה וְכֵ֧ן הַתַּחְתּוֹנָ֛ה יַעֲלֶ֥ה עַל־הָעֶלְיוֹנָ֖ה לַתִּיכוֹנָֽה׃

controles.web: The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the breadth of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.
controles.kjv: And there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house was still upward, and so increased from the lowest chamber to the highest by the midst.
controles.livre: E havia maior largura nas câmaras laterais mais para cima, pois o entorno do templo subia de andar em andar ao redor do templo; por isso o templo era mais largo acima; e se subia da câmara baixa se subia à alta pela do meio.

versos.hebraico: וְרָאִ֧יתִי לַבַּ֛יִת גֹּ֖בַהּ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב מיסדות הַצְּלָעוֹת֙ מְל֣וֹ הַקָּנֶ֔ה שֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת אַצִּֽילָה׃

controles.web: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around: the foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.
controles.kjv: I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers were a full reed of six great cubits.
controles.livre: E olhei para a altura da casa ao redor; os fundamentos das câmaras laterais eram de uma cana inteira de seis côvados maiores de tamanho.

versos.hebraico: רֹ֣חַב הַקִּ֧יר אֲֽשֶׁר־לַצֵּלָ֛ע אֶל־הַח֖וּץ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר מֻנָּ֔ח בֵּ֥ית צְלָע֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַבָּֽיִת׃

controles.web: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side rooms, on the outside, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.
controles.kjv: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side chamber without, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side chambers that were within.
controles.livre: A largura da parede das câmaras externas era de cinco côvados, e o espaço que restava era o lugar das câmaras laterais que eram junto ao templo.

versos.hebraico: וּבֵ֨ין הַלְּשָׁכ֜וֹת רֹ֣חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֛ה סָבִ֥יב לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: Between the rooms was a breadth of twenty cubits around the house on every side.
controles.kjv: And between the chambers was the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.
controles.livre: E entre as câmaras havia a largura de vinte côvados ao redor do templo por todos os lados.

versos.hebraico: וּפֶ֤תַח הַצֵּלָע֙ לַמֻּנָּ֔ח פֶּ֤תַח אֶחָד֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וּפֶ֥תַח אֶחָ֖ד לַדָּר֑וֹם וְרֹ֨חַב֙ מְק֣וֹם הַמֻּנָּ֔ח חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.
controles.kjv: And the doors of the side chambers were toward the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left was five cubits round about.
controles.livre: E as entradas de cada câmara estavam voltadas para o espaço vazio; uma entrada para o norte, e outra entrada para o sul; e a largura do espaço vazio era de cinco côvados ao redor.

versos.hebraico: וְהַבִּנְיָ֡ן אֲשֶׁר֩ אֶל־פְּנֵ֨י הַגִּזְרָ֜ה פְּאַ֣ת דֶּֽרֶךְ־הַיָּ֗ם רֹ֚חַב שִׁבְעִ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְקִ֧יר הַבִּנְיָ֛ן חָֽמֵשׁ־אַמּ֥וֹת רֹ֖חַב סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב וְאָרְכּ֖וֹ תִּשְׁעִ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃

controles.web: The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.
controles.kjv: Now the building that was before the separate place at the end toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.
controles.livre: E o edifício que estava diante do lugar separado ao lado do ocidente era da largura de setenta côvados; e a parede do edifício era de cinco côvados de largura ao redor, e seu comprimento era de noventa côvados.

versos.hebraico: וּמָדַ֣ד אֶת־הַבַּ֔יִת אֹ֖רֶךְ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה וְהַגִּזְרָ֤ה וְהַבִּנְיָה֙ וְקִ֣ירוֹתֶ֔יהָ אֹ֖רֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃

controles.web: So he measured the house, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;
controles.kjv: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;
controles.livre: E mediu o templo, cem côvados de comprimento; e o lugar separado, e o edifício, e suas paredes, de comprimento de cem côvados;

versos.hebraico: וְרֹחַב֩ פְּנֵ֨י הַבַּ֧יִת וְהַגִּזְרָ֛ה לַקָּדִ֖ים מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃

controles.web: also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.
controles.kjv: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.
controles.livre: E a largura da dianteira do templo, e do lugar separado ao oriente, era de cem côvados.

versos.hebraico: וּמָדַ֣ד אֹֽרֶךְ־הַ֠בִּנְיָן אֶל־פְּנֵ֨י הַגִּזְרָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־אַחֲרֶ֧יהָ ואתוקיהא מִפּ֥וֹ וּמִפּ֖וֹ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה וְהַֽהֵיכָל֙ הַפְּנִימִ֔י וְאֻֽלַמֵּ֖י הֶחָצֵֽר׃

controles.web: He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits; and the inner temple, and the porches of the court;
controles.kjv: And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which was behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;
controles.livre: Também mediu o comprimento do edifício que estava diante do lugar separado que estava detrás dele, e suas galerias de um lado e do outro eram de cem côvados, com o templo interno, e os alpendres do pátio.

versos.hebraico: הַסִּפִּ֡ים וְהַחַלּוֹנִ֣ים הָ֠אֲטֻמוֹת וְהָאַתִּיקִ֤ים׀ סָבִיב֙ לִשְׁלָשְׁתָּ֔ם נֶ֧גֶד הַסַּ֛ף שְׂחִ֥יף עֵ֖ץ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב וְהָאָ֨רֶץ֙ עַד־הַֽחַלֹּנ֔וֹת וְהַֽחַלֹּנ֖וֹת מְכֻסּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, over against the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),
controles.kjv: The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered;
controles.livre: Os umbrais, e as janelas estreitas, e as galerias ao redor dos três andares, de frente ao umbral, estavam cobertas de madeira ao redor, desde o chão até as janelas; e as janelas estavam cobertas,

versos.hebraico: עַל־מֵעַ֣ל הַפֶּ֡תַח וְעַד־הַבַּיִת֩ הַפְּנִימִ֨י וְלַח֜וּץ וְאֶל־כָּל־הַקִּ֨יר סָבִ֧יב׀ סָבִ֛יב בַּפְּנִימִ֥י וּבַחִיצ֖וֹן מִדּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.
controles.kjv: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.
controles.livre: Até o que havia acima da porta, e até o templo interior e exterior, e até toda a parede em redor, por dentro e por fora, tudo por medida.

versos.hebraico: וְעָשׂ֥וּי כְּרוּבִ֖ים וְתִֽמֹרִ֑ים וְתִֽמֹרָה֙ בֵּין־כְּר֣וּב לִכְר֔וּב וּשְׁנַ֥יִם פָּנִ֖ים לַכְּרֽוּב׃

controles.web: It was made with cherubim and palm trees; and a palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces;
controles.kjv: And it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree was between a cherub and a cherub; and every cherub had two faces;
controles.livre: E era feita com querubins e palmeiras, de maneira que cada palmeira ficava entre um querubim e outro; e cada querubim tinha dois rostos:

versos.hebraico: וּפְנֵ֨י אָדָ֤ם אֶל־הַתִּֽמֹרָה֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וּפְנֵֽי־כְפִ֥יר אֶל־הַתִּֽמֹרָ֖ה מִפּ֑וֹ עָשׂ֥וּי אֶל־כָּל־הַבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around:
controles.kjv: So that the face of a man was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: it was made through all the house round about.
controles.livre: Um rosto de homem voltado para palmeira da uma lado, e um rosto de leão voltado para a palmeira do outro lado, assim era por todo o templo ao redor.

versos.hebraico: מֵהָאָ֨רֶץ֙ עַד־מֵעַ֣ל הַפֶּ֔תַח הַכְּרוּבִ֥ים וְהַתִּֽמֹרִ֖ים עֲשׂוּיִ֑ם וְקִ֖יר הַׄהֵׄיׄכָֽׄלׄ׃

controles.web: from the ground to above the door were cherubim and palm trees made: thus was the wall of the temple.
controles.kjv: From the ground unto above the door were cherubims and palm trees made, and on the wall of the temple.
controles.livre: Desde o chão até encima da entrada foram feitos os querubins e as palmeiras, e também por toda a parede do templo.

versos.hebraico: הַֽהֵיכָ֖ל מְזוּזַ֣ת רְבֻעָ֑ה וּפְנֵ֣י הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה כַּמַּרְאֶֽה׃

controles.web: As for the temple, the door posts were squared; and as for the face of the sanctuary, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.
controles.kjv: The posts of the temple were squared, and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance of the one as the appearance of the other.
controles.livre: Os umbrais do templo eram quadrados; e a dianteira do santuário tinha a aparência como a da outra.

versos.hebraico: הַמִּזְבֵּ֡חַ עֵ֣ץ שָׁלוֹשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת גָּבֹ֜הַּ וְאָרְכּ֣וֹ שְׁתַּֽיִם־אַמּ֗וֹת וּמִקְצֹֽעוֹתָיו֙ ל֔וֹ וְאָרְכּ֥וֹ וְקִֽירֹתָ֖יו עֵ֑ץ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלַ֔י זֶ֚ה הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits; and its corners, and its length, and its walls, were of wood: and he said to me, This is the table that is before Yahweh.
controles.kjv: The altar of wood was three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were of wood: and he said unto me, This is the table that is before the Lord.
controles.livre: O altar de madeira era de três côvados de altura, e seu comprimento de dois côvados; e seus cantos, seu comprimento, e suas laterais eram de madeira. E ele me falou: Esta é a mesa que está diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁתַּ֧יִם דְּלָת֛וֹת לַֽהֵיכָ֖ל וְלַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
controles.kjv: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
controles.livre: E o templo e o santuário, ambos tinham duas portas.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁתַּ֥יִם דְּלָת֖וֹת לַדְּלָת֑וֹת שְׁ֚תַּיִם מוּסַבּ֣וֹת דְּלָת֔וֹת שְׁ֚תַּיִם לְדֶ֣לֶת אֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּ֥י דְלָת֖וֹת לָאַחֶֽרֶת׃

controles.web: The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.
controles.kjv: And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door.
controles.livre: E em cada portada havia duas divisões que podiam se virar; duas divisões em uma porta, e duas na outra.

versos.hebraico: וַעֲשׂוּיָ֨ה אֲלֵיהֶ֜ן אֶל־דַּלְת֤וֹת הַֽהֵיכָל֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים וְתִֽמֹרִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשׂוּיִ֖ם לַקִּיר֑וֹת וְעָ֥ב עֵ֛ץ אֶל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאוּלָ֖ם מֵהַחֽוּץ׃

controles.web: There were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubim and palm trees, like as were made on the walls; and there was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.
controles.kjv: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.
controles.livre: E nelas, nas portas do templo, foram feitos querubins e palmeiras, assim como estavam feitos nas paredes; e havia uma viga espessa de madeira na dianteira do alpendre por fora.

versos.hebraico: וְחַלּוֹנִ֨ים אֲטֻמ֤וֹת וְתִֽמֹרִים֙ מִפּ֣וֹ וּמִפּ֔וֹ אֶל־כִּתְפ֖וֹת הָֽאוּלָ֑ם וְצַלְע֥וֹת הַבַּ֖יִת וְהָעֻבִּֽים׃

controles.web: There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch: thus were the side rooms of the house, and the thresholds.
controles.kjv: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.
controles.livre: E havia janelas estreitas e palmeiras de um lado e do outro, pelas laterais do alpendre, assim como nas câmaras laterais do templo, e nas vigas espessas.
